title: Alloy Processing
summary: Three levels with a tier change at level 2.
description: Requires Refining Lv.1. Lv.1 uses research tier 1; Lv.2 and Lv.3 use tier 2.
The computing total grows each level. Material totals stay unchanged.
Only levels 1 and 3 have rewards. A tier 1 database can process the first completed level while a higher level remains out of reach.
